decision.observation: 2:20 pm; the C press reeled the line in—bobber now at the rod tip above the farmer (~0.62,0.13). It was another nibble, not a hook. Farmer may be facing north again.
decision.hypothesis: Tapping A or nothing then S will re-face south; then hold C to cast into the pond.
decision.memory: After every reel-in, re-face south (brief S tap) before holding C, else the bobber lands north. Nibble dips consistently just reel in; waiting for the larger 'HIT!' text is the reliable hook cue.
